methodological_scope_and_synthetic_1D_ca.test_classification: Synthetic 1D illustrative collision-axis model (NOT an observational chi^2 fit to raw 2D lensing maps)
methodological_scope_and_synthetic_1D_ca.synthetic_target_definition: kappa_synth_target_1D is a self-constructed 1D synthetic reference curve built from the sum of the model's own four King profiles plus two unfiltered galaxy weights (w_synth_main = 22.9765, w_synth_sub = 21.3095) tuned to match the illustrative peak heights kappa(-350 kpc) = 0.320 and kappa(+300 kpc) = 0.220.
methodological_scope_and_synthetic_1D_ca.normalized_synthetic_mse_definition: synth_mse_norm_vs_target (M_synth = 32.089 for GR_baryon_only and TAL_local_Yukawa_L10km_alphaY1, 20.723 for Macro_unscreened_bulk_baryon, and 1.637 for Macro_collisionless_compact_clock) is the mean-squared deviation from kappa_synth_target_1D normalized by a uniform reference scale sigma_ref = 0.020 across the 321 grid points. It is NOT an observational reduced chi^2_nu fit to Clowe et al. (2006) or Bradac et al. (2006) data, which would require a published 2D convergence map, full error covariance matrix, pre-registered spatial selection, and degree-of-freedom subtraction (N_dof = N_bins - p).
methodological_scope_and_synthetic_1D_ca.model_dependent_thresholds_caveat: The peak-dominance threshold eta_gal/eta_gas >= 5.1204 and the < 5 kpc centroid-offset threshold eta_gal/eta_gas >= 25.6650 are model-dependent thresholds specific to the chosen 1D King geometry (R_c = 65-150 kpc) and macroscopic Helmholtz scale L_macro = 300 kpc, not a general model-independent physical theorem.
methodological_scope_and_synthetic_1D_ca.phenomenological_clock_weights_caveat: Setting eta_gas = 0 and fitting two separate galactic weights (eta_gal_main = 31.7448, eta_gal_sub = 24.1556) in Case 2B are phenomenological, illustrative assumptions not derived from the covariant scalar-tensor action.

test1_local_yukawa_L10km_alphaY1.scientific_verdict: At fixed L = 10 km and alpha_Y = 1, the short-range Yukawa fifth force is purely a compact-object/neutron-star effect and produces zero macroscopic modification to Bullet Cluster lensing (delta_kappa_conf = 0 identically; |delta_kappa_disf/kappa_bary| <= 2.17e-36, and < 1e-40 in the outer halo). The convergence peaks remain locked to the X-ray gas centroids (-175.44 kpc in the 4-component global sum or -170.7 kpc in the shock-separated pair, and +137.01 kpc or +142.3 kpc for the subcluster), missing the observed galaxy centroids (-350 kpc and +300 kpc) by 158-179 kpc with 7.1x smaller peak amplitude.

case2A_bulk_baryon.verdict: Even with a macroscopic screening scale L_macro = 300 kpc and eta_bulk = 8.65 (boosting peak convergence by 7.11x to match kappa = 0.320), any static kernel sourced universally by smoothed bulk baryon density (rho_gas + rho_gal) keeps its convergence peaks locked to the X-ray gas (-176.02 kpc and +138.35 kpc; or -185 kpc and +155 kpc under broader smoothing), failing the Clowe et al. (2006) spatial offset test by 162-174 kpc.

case2B_collisionless_compact_clock.verdict: Reproducing the observed galaxy-centered convergence peaks kappa(-350 kpc) = 0.320 and kappa(+300 kpc) = 0.220 with < 5 kpc centroid offset (actual offsets +2.14 kpc and -0.55 kpc) requires either (1) compactness/potential-well-depth weighting where the macroscopic clock field is sourced by deep stellar/compact-remnant potential wells (eta_gal,main = 31.74, eta_gal,sub = 24.16; peak-dominance threshold eta_gal/eta_gas >= 5.12 and < 5 kpc offset threshold eta_gal/eta_gas >= 25.66), or (2) non-equilibrium collisionless scalar memory with relaxation time tau_relax >= 150 Myr > t_cross ~ 39 Myr during the v_coll = 4500 km/s supersonic merger.
